create_embedding_list_concat: create an EmbeddingList with concat=True to concatenate multiple sub-embeddings into a single tensor
create_embedding_list_tuple: create an EmbeddingList with concat=False to return sub-embeddings as a tuple of tensors
forward_embedding_list: run the EmbeddingList forward pass with token-level embedding inputs to get combined embeddings
visualize_embedding_list: visualize all child embedding modules in an EmbeddingList using a TensorBoard SummaryWriter
review_embedding_list_init: review the EmbeddingList constructor to understand how sub-embeddings are filtered and indexed
